item.caption:
🇺🇸 I VOTED FROM CHINA! 🇺🇸

Godspeed, little ballot! ✉️❤️

Voting as an American living overseas is no small accomplishment! Between navigating the absentee ballot process, finding envelopes, figuring out international mailing, and getting everything where it needs to go, exercising my democratic right took some serious determination.

But I did it! From Wenzhou, China, halfway around the world, I made my voice heard.

Living abroad gives you a unique perspective on your home country. Distance doesn’t diminish how much I care about America’s future. If anything, it makes me appreciate even more the importance of democracy, civic responsibility, and the privilege of having a voice.

Democracy is worth the effort, even from 7,000 miles away.

Now, here’s hoping my ballot makes its journey safely and arrives in time!

🇺🇸❤️🗳️ Every voice matters. Every vote matters.

#IVoted #VotingFromAbroad #AmericansOverseas #DemocracyMatters #WenzhouChina
